engine.description: Controls the native server BattlEye anti-cheat setting. Apply globally and restart the Battlegroup after saving. The current Docker game image defaults to disabled. A BattlEye launch argument takes precedence over this setting.
engine.label: BattlEye Anti-Cheat

engine.description: Display name shown for this server instance. Used as the Dimension name when the server is a Dimension server.
Multiplier applied to personal mining output for all players.
Multiplier applied to vehicle mining output for all players.
Multiplier applied to resource yield inside PvP zones.
Multiplier applied to durability damage taken by vehicles. Valid range 0-10; 0 = damage off.
Toggles sandstorm treasure spawning. 1 = ON (default), 0 = OFF.
Seconds of invulnerability granted to a vehicle after a player exits it near a sandworm.
Seconds of invulnerability granted to vehicles after a server restart, to prevent immediate sandworm attacks.
Toggles whether players take sun exposure/heat damage. True/1 = ON (default), False/0 = OFF.
Maximum number of vehicles a single player is allowed to own at once. 0 = no limit.
Multiplier applied to fuel burn duration. Larger values make fuel last longer. Conservative test range 0.1-10.0 (not enforced); 1.0 is normal.
Multiplier applied to Faction XP rewarded from Landsraad missions.
Multiplier applied to House Credits rewarded from Landsraad missions.
Multiplier applied to Specialization XP rewarded from Landsraad missions.
Overrides how long it takes to process a body in a Deathstill. Value is the length of the cycle in seconds.
Gives double loot when the encounter difficulty is above 0. Field-confirmed with dungeon loot.
Whether per-player loot is regenerated each time a player interacts with a loot container. Field-confirmed. Enabling this can make a single container farmable indefinitely.

game.description: UserGame force-PvP flag for all partitions within the selected scope. The Console flags an overlap with an explicit PvE selector. This is separate from Custom Settings' PVPMode; priority between the two systems is not verified.

Controls the Security Zones subsystem, which manages safe/restricted areas within a map. This does not select a PvP or PvE instance. Disabling zones may allow combat in previously protected areas; exact boundaries depend on the game build.
Deterioration tick rate. 0 = off, 1-10 typical.
Intended to enable or disable the spice spawning system. In live testing, setting this to False did not reliably stop new fields from appearing. Do not rely on this setting to halt all spawning.
Seconds a spice field spends 'priming' (visible but not yet harvestable) before becoming active. Lower = fields become harvestable sooner after appearing.
How often (seconds) the spice manager re-evaluates spawn/despawn state. Lower = more responsive but more frequent server work.
How often (seconds) the spice manager does a full refresh pass. Distinct from the tick rate above -- this is the slower, heavier pass.
How often (seconds) the global (cross-map) spice manager refreshes. Affects spawn pacing at the whole-server level, not a single map.
If true, a spice bloom must actually be seen by a player to register/replicate. False lets blooms happen unwitnessed.
Whether spice blooms replicate to clients beyond normal render range. True can make distant blooms visible/audible sooner.
Whether spice fields themselves replicate to clients beyond normal render range, independent of the bloom replication setting above.

Yield multiplier: how much harvestable spice resource a field produces per unit of its underlying node value. This is NOT a spawn-count or field-size control -- it only affects how much spice an already-spawned field yields.
Whether Coriolis storms spawn automatically on their normal cycle.
Base year shipped in the Coriolis configuration. Normally leave this unchanged when matching a regional schedule.
game.label: Cycle Start Year

game.description: Base month (1-12) shipped in the Coriolis configuration. Normally leave this unchanged when matching a regional schedule.
game.label: Cycle Start Month

game.description: UTC calendar day of the month (1-31). Regional master schedule anchor dates: Europe, North America, and South America use day 3; Asia and Oceania use day 2.
game.label: Cycle Start Day

game.description: UTC hour (0-23). Regional master schedules: Europe 05, North America 10, South America 08, Asia 09, and Oceania 19.
game.label: Cycle Start Hour

game.description: UTC minute (0-59) for the Coriolis cycle start.
game.label: Cycle Start Minute

game.description: Funcom's seed index for the base Coriolis cycle. Leave at 0 unless intentionally coordinating a different cycle seed.
game.label: Cycle Start Seed Index

game.description: Requests Funcom's farm-level restart when the Coriolis cycle ends. Dune Docker coordinates one clean restart of Director, Gateway, and every world map so all processes load the same new cycle seed, while PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, TextRouter, the Console, and orchestration remain online.
game.label: Restart Game Farm At Coriolis Cycle End

game.description: Maximum number of land-claim segments (flags) a player may own.
Maximum number of times a blueprinted building can be extended.
Maximum number of times a Base Backup can be extended.

Cooldown in seconds for each of the ten vertical Staking Unit extension levels. Leave empty to inherit a broader scope or use the game's progressive defaults. Server-only; applies after the affected maps restart.
game.label: Vertical Staking Unit Cooldown (Seconds)

game.description: Cooldown in seconds for each of the ten horizontal Staking Unit extension levels. Leave empty to inherit a broader scope or use the game's progressive defaults. Server-only; applies after the affected maps restart.
game.label: Horizontal Staking Unit Cooldown (Seconds)

game.description: Whether a player drops their inventory as loot when killed (PvP looting).
Whether a player drops loot when downed/defeated (not a full death).
Scales durability loss for all items. 0 = off.

Legacy UserGame game-mode flag (bPvPEnabled). The Console uses this only as a fallback when partition selectors are absent. It does not establish whether PvP is active in game or override Custom Settings by itself.
game.label: Legacy PvP Flag

game.description: Legacy UserGame game-mode flag (bServerPVE). True alone is not proof that this instance is PvE: partition selectors and Custom Settings' PVPMode are separate controls. The Console does not verify their priority inside the game.
game.label: Legacy Server PvE Flag

game.description: Master toggle for the hydration / thirst system. Off = players never get thirsty.
How quickly players consume water.
Additional water drain during sandstorms.
Water amount when a player spawns.
Whether items are dropped when a player respawns on a different map.

Roll threshold from 0 to 1; lower values increase the jackpot chance. The default 0.95 gives a 5% chance. This can be overridden per map or Sietch, and the public server page shows Varies when those scopes differ.
game.label: Augment Jackpot Roll Threshold

serverCustom.description: Custom Settings' PvP policy: NoPVP, Limited or FullPVP. UserGame has separate partition and legacy controls. Their priority is not verified across game builds; avoid contradictory settings and verify the result in game. The map badge describes UserGame configuration only.
serverCustom.label: PvP Mode

serverCustom.description: Enforces building restriction limits (e.g. disallowing construction inside dungeons/restricted areas).
Scales building-piece limits, including lights. Values above Funcom's recommended range are supported, but may increase server and client load.
Cooldown in hours before the Base Reconstruction Tool can pack the same base again. The game-enforced minimum is 0.2 hours (12 minutes).
serverCustom.label: Base Reconstruction Cooldown (Hours)
